alerts.title: Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road are temporarily closed due to snow
alerts.description: Tioga Road (continuation of Highway 120 through the park) and Glacier Point Road temporarily closed due to snow. Call 209/372-0200 (then 1, 1) to check road conditions in the park.

alerts.title: No overnight parking on Tioga & Glacier Point Roads
alerts.description: Overnight parking is not allowed on Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road, including all parking lots reachable from these roads.
